_about: COCI C-ID claims set aside. A college enters a course's C-ID in COCI with no gatekeeper, and the identity layer trusts that entry as it trusts the ASCCC approval table. A claim listed here is not trusted: the member export (excel_to_dashboard.py) treats its CIDNumber as blank, and kb/_apply_cid_claim_holds.py moves any articulation record it carried to the course's home. A claim qualifies only when four signals agree: the ASCCC C-ID approval table holds no approval for it (kb/cid_articulation_joins.json), and the course's subject, its TOP family and its title all disagree with every other member of the claimed C-ID (kb/_audit_cid_claims.py finds them). The home is the identity the same course holds at its sister colleges. Reverse a hold by deleting its entry and re-running the apply script with --rollback on its receipt. Ask the college to correct COCI; when it does, the hold has nothing left to hold.
